method: Uniform effective density calibrated to original mass / original signed mesh volume. Identify plate triangles by original vs no-plate visual difference using 1e-7 m vertex rounding, validate 140x200x14 mm bounds, remove matching collision triangles. Screws retained. Remaining COM and inertia integrated over signed tetrahedra. Geometry-based estimate, not CAD material properties.
gripper_fingers: No inertials added: current RViz/kinematics use does not require them.
